examples.question_text: A nurse has a taxable income of $\$79\,650$. Using the simplified Medicare levy rate of $2\%$, calculate her levy to the nearest cent.

A therapist earns an annual salary of $\$86\,400$ and $\$218.75$ in bank interest. Her allowable deductions are union fees of $\$635.40$ and work equipment costing $\$1248.60$. Round her calculated taxable income down to a whole dollar, then calculate her Medicare levy at $2\%$ to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*}\text{Gross income}&=86\,400+218.75\\&=\$86\,618.75\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\text{Deductions}&=635.40+1248.60\\&=\$1884.00\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\text{Calculated taxable income}&=86\,618.75-1884.00\\&=\$84\,734.75\end{align*}$

Rounded down, the taxable income is $\$84\,734$.

$\begin{align*}\text{Medicare levy}&=0.02\times84\,734\\&=\$1694.68\end{align*}$

examples.question_text: A physiotherapist earns $\$2980$ per fortnight and has annual allowable deductions of $\$1560$. Use $26$ fortnights per year. Calculate her Medicare levy at $2\%$ to the nearest cent.
A community nurse paid a Medicare levy of $\$1736.40$, calculated at $2\%$ of her taxable income. Find her taxable income to the nearest dollar.
examples.solution_text:
Let $x$ be her taxable income in dollars.

$\begin{align*}0.02x&=1736.40\\x&=\frac{1736.40}{0.02}\\x&=86\,820\end{align*}$

Her taxable income was $\$86\,820$.

examples.question_text: A pharmacist has a taxable income of $\$69\,250$ and income tax payable of $\$12\,973.25$. Calculate her total tax payable, including a Medicare levy of $2\%$, to the nearest cent.

A social worker has a taxable income of $\$98\,600$. For this exercise, the supplied tax table gives income tax of $\$5092$ plus $32.5$ cents for each dollar over $\$45\,000$ when taxable income is between $\$45\,001$ and $\$120\,000$. Calculate her total tax payable, including a Medicare levy of $2\%$, to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
Her taxable income falls in the supplied bracket.

$\begin{align*}\text{Excess}&=98\,600-45\,000\\&=\$53\,600\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\text{Income tax payable}&=5092+0.325\times53\,600\\&=\$22\,512.00\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\text{Medicare levy}&=0.02\times98\,600\\&=\$1972.00\end{align*}$

$\begin{align*}\text{Total tax payable}&=22\,512.00+1972.00\\&=\$24\,484.00\end{align*}$

coverage.summary: Authored six examples covering all distinct accepted assessment methods, using changed values and the supplied booklet's simplified model. Assessments were classified only; none were altered or re-audited. Questions and solutions are separate editable fields, with aligned single-dollar mathematics and plain solution prose inheriting blue. No diagrams are needed for these numerical methods. Independent review and actual visual capture remain subsequent stages.

examples.derivation: 79,650 × 0.02 = 1,593.00. The levy is $1593.00, matching the booklet's direct percentage method.
